name: Premarital Sex
overview: Scripture clearly defines premarital sex as fornication, a sin that believers are called to abstain from as part of living a holy life (Acts 15:20; Ephesians 5:3). God's design for sexual union is within the covenant of marriage, where a man and woman become one flesh (Genesis 2:24). The Old Testament also underscores the responsibility and sanctity of this union, requiring a man who lies with an unbetrothed woman to marry her (Exodus 22:16). Believers are exhorted to mortify sinful desires, including fornication, as these are works of the flesh contrary to a Christ-centered life (Galatians 5:19; Colossians 3:5).
